Playful Cookie Consent Widget

This delightful GDPR consent popup replaces sterile compliance panels with delightful, tactile interactions. Built using GSAP and canvas confetti physics, it features bouncy, spring-loaded toggle switches and a floating cookie icon that triggers state restoration. Preferences are kept persistently in localStorage, and it integrates an Escape keyboard listener for desktop accessibility.

const panel = document.getElementById("cookiePanel");
const openBtn = document.getElementById("openBuddy");
const toggles = Array.from(document.querySelectorAll(".toggle"));
const acceptAll = document.getElementById("acceptAll");
const savePrefs = document.getElementById("savePrefs");
const declineAll = document.getElementById("declineAll");
const confettiCanvas = document.getElementById("confetti");

const defaultState = {
  necessary: true,
  preferences: false,
  analytics: false,
  marketing: false
};

function getKey() {
  return "playful_cookie_consent_v1";
}

function readConsent() {
  try {
    const raw = localStorage.getItem(getKey());
    return raw ? JSON.parse(raw) : null;
  } catch (e) {
    return null;
  }
}
function writeConsent(obj) {
  localStorage.setItem(getKey(), JSON.stringify(obj));
  window.dispatchEvent(
    new CustomEvent("cookieConsentChanged", { detail: obj })
  );
}

function applyTogglesFromState(state) {
  toggles.forEach((t) => {
    const key = t.dataset.key;
    const val = !!state[key];
    if (val) t.classList.add("on");
    else t.classList.remove("on");
    t.setAttribute("aria-pressed", String(val));
  });
}

function readTogglesToState() {
  const obj = {};
  toggles.forEach((t) => (obj[t.dataset.key] = t.classList.contains("on")));
  obj.necessary = true;
  return obj;
}

const stored = readConsent();
if (stored) {
  applyTogglesFromState(Object.assign({}, defaultState, stored));
} else {
  panel.classList.add("visible");
}

openBtn.addEventListener("click", () => {
  panel.classList.toggle("visible");
  gsap.fromTo(
    panel,
    { scale: 0.96, opacity: 0 },
    { scale: 1, opacity: 1, duration: 0.35, ease: "power2.out" }
  );
});

toggles.forEach((t) => {
  t.addEventListener("click", () => {
    if (t.dataset.key === "necessary") return;
    t.classList.toggle("on");
    gsap.fromTo(
      t.querySelector(".dot"),
      { y: 0, scale: 1 },
      { y: -4, scale: 1.03, duration: 0.12, yoyo: true, repeat: 1 }
    );
  });
});

acceptAll.addEventListener("click", () => {
  const all = {
    necessary: true,
    preferences: true,
    analytics: true,
    marketing: true
  };
  writeConsent(all);
  applyTogglesFromState(all);
  celebrate();
  panel.classList.remove("visible");
});

savePrefs.addEventListener("click", () => {
  const state = readTogglesToState();
  writeConsent(state);
  panel.classList.remove("visible");
  toast("Preferences saved");
});

declineAll.addEventListener("click", () => {
  const minimal = {
    necessary: true,
    preferences: false,
    analytics: false,
    marketing: false
  };
  writeConsent(minimal);
  applyTogglesFromState(minimal);
  panel.classList.remove("visible");
  toast("Only essential cookies allowed");
});

function toast(txt) {
  const el = document.createElement("div");
  el.textContent = txt;
  el.style.cssText =
    "position:fixed;right:18px;bottom:120px;background:rgba(255,255,255,0.06);padding:10px 12px;border-radius:10px;font-weight:600;z-index:99999";
  document.body.appendChild(el);
  gsap.fromTo(el, { y: 20, opacity: 0 }, { y: 0, opacity: 1, duration: 0.35 });
  setTimeout(
    () =>
      gsap.to(el, {
        opacity: 0,
        y: -8,
        duration: 0.45,
        onComplete: () => el.remove()
      }),
    2000
  );
}

function celebrate() {
  const w = (confettiCanvas.width = innerWidth);
  const h = (confettiCanvas.height = innerHeight);
  const ctx = confettiCanvas.getContext("2d");
  const particles = [];
  for (let i = 0; i < 60; i++) {
    particles.push({
      x: Math.random() * w,
      y: Math.random() * -80,
      vy: 2 + Math.random() * 6,
      vx: -3 + Math.random() * 6,
      r: 6 + Math.random() * 8,
      rot: Math.random() * 360,
      vr: -6 + Math.random() * 12,
      c: ["#FFB86B", "#FFD974", "#60a5fa", "#5eead4"][
        Math.floor(Math.random() * 4)
      ]
    });
  }
  let t = 0;
  const id = setInterval(() => {
    ctx.clearRect(0, 0, w, h);
    t += 1;
    particles.forEach((p) => {
      p.x += p.vx;
      p.y += p.vy;
      p.vy += 0.08;
      p.rot += p.vr;
      ctx.save();
      ctx.translate(p.x, p.y);
      ctx.rotate((p.rot * Math.PI) / 180);
      ctx.fillStyle = p.c;
      ctx.fillRect(-p.r / 2, -p.r / 2, p.r, p.r);
      ctx.restore();
    });
    if (t > 120) {
      clearInterval(id);
      ctx.clearRect(0, 0, w, h);
    }
  }, 1000 / 60);
}

window.getCookieConsent = () => readConsent() || defaultState;
window.hasConsented = (key) => (readConsent() || defaultState)[key] === true;

document.addEventListener("keydown", (e) => {
  if (e.key === "Escape") panel.classList.remove("visible");
});

if (!stored) {
  setTimeout(() => {
    if (!readConsent()) {
      gsap.fromTo(
        openBtn,
        { scale: 1 },
        { scale: 1.04, duration: 0.6, yoyo: true, repeat: 3 }
      );
    }
  }, 1800);
}

document.getElementById("moreInfo").addEventListener("click", () => {

  );
});

console.info(

);

*,
*::before,
*::after {
  margin: 0;
  padding: 0;
  box-sizing: border-box;
}

body {
  font-family: sans-serif;
}

.container {
  width: min(95%, 425px);
  margin: 1em auto;
}

/* ---- invoice ---- */
.invoice-container {
  position: relative;
  margin-bottom: 2em;
  height: 630px;
}

.invoice-slot {
  width: 100%;
  height: 120px;
  background-color: #2b2b2b;
  border: 2px solid #2c2c2c;
  border-radius: 1em;
  box-shadow: 0 0 1px 0 #000, 0 5px 15px 0 rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.45);
}

.slot-hole {
  background-color: #000;
  border-radius: 100vmax;
  width: 90%;
  height: 25px;
  margin: 1em auto;
  border: 1px solid #1b1b1b;
  box-shadow: 0 0 1px 0 #000, 0 5px 15px 0 rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.45);
}

.invoice {
  position: absolute;
  width: 85%;
  top: 1.5em;
  left: 50%;
  transform: translateX(-50%);
  background-color: #fff;
  color: #6b7280;
  padding: 1em;
  border-radius: 0.5em;
  box-shadow: 0 5px 25px 0 rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.15);
}

.invoice::before {
  content: "";
  position: absolute;
  width: 100%;
  height: 80px;
  left: 0;
  top: 0;
  background: linear-gradient(
    180deg,
    rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.95) 0%,
    rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.75) 10%,
    rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.65) 25%,
    rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.45) 40%,
    rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.25) 60%,
    transparent 100%
  );
}

.invoice .title {
  position: relative;
  font-size: 1.15rem;
  padding: 0.55em 0;
  letter-spacing: 0.5px;
  text-align: center;
  margin-bottom: 1.25em;
  font-weight: 500;
  color: #1b1b1b;
}

.invoice .title::before {
  content: "";
  position: absolute;
  height: 1.5px;
  width: 100%;
  top: 0;
  left: 0;
  background-image: repeating-linear-gradient(
    90deg,
    #1b1b1b,
    #1b1b1b 8px,
    transparent 8px,
    transparent 16px
  );
}

.invoice .title::after {
  content: "";
  position: absolute;
  height: 1.5px;
  width: 100%;
  bottom: 0;
  left: 0;
  background-image: repeating-linear-gradient(
    90deg,
    #1b1b1b,
    #1b1b1b 8px,
    transparent 8px,
    transparent 16px
  );
}

.invoice .amount,
.invoice .payment-status .heading {
  display: flex;
  align-items: center;
  justify-content: space-between;
  font-size: 1rem;
  margin-bottom: 0.5em;
}

.invoice .amount .value {
  font-weight: 700;
  color: #000;
}

.invoice .payment-status {
  border: 1px solid #ddd;
  padding: 1em;
  border-radius: 15px;
  margin-top: 1em;
}

.invoice .payment-status .heading span {
  text-transform: uppercase;
  font-weight: 500;
  color: #000;
}

.payers-list {
  list-style-type: none;
  margin: 0.5em 0;
}

.payers-list li {
  border-bottom: 1px solid #eee;
  display: flex;
  align-items: center;
}

.payers-list li p {
  flex-grow: 1;
  display: flex;
  justify-content: space-between;
  align-items: center;
  font-size: 0.9rem;
  padding: 0.5em;
}

.payers-list .payer-image-container {
  padding: 0.5em;
  border-right: 1px solid #eee;
}

.payers-list .payer-image-container img {
  width: 35px;
  border-radius: 50%;
}

.payers-list .pay-tag {
  border: 1px solid #ddd;
  border-radius: 8px;
  padding: 0.3em 0.5em;
}

.fa-circle-check {
  color: #22c55e;
}

.fa-clock {
  color: #d97706;
}

.btn-group {
  display: flex;
  align-items: center;
  gap: 0.75em;
  margin-top: 1.25em;
}

.status-progress {
  position: relative;
  margin: 1.5em 0 0.5em 0;
  height: 6px;
  background-image: linear-gradient(90deg, #000 75%, #eee 75%);
}

.checkpoint {
  position: absolute;
  background: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.95);
  border: 2px solid red;
  width: 26px;
  height: 26px;
  border-radius: 50%;
  border: 0.5px solid #eee;
  display: flex;
  justify-content: center;
  align-items: center;
  box-shadow: 0 5px 10px 0 rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.15);
}

.checkpoint .circle {
  display: inline-block;
  width: 15px;
  height: 15px;
  border-radius: 50%;
  background-color: #000;
}

.checkpoint:nth-child(1) {
  left: 0;
  top: 0;
  transform: translate(-5%, -40%);
}

.checkpoint:nth-child(2) {
  left: 25%;
  top: 0;
  transform: translate(-25%, -40%);
}

.checkpoint:nth-child(3) {
  left: 50%;
  top: 0;
  transform: translate(-50%, -40%);
}

.checkpoint:nth-child(4) {
  left: 75%;
  top: 0;
  transform: translate(-75%, -40%);
}

.checkpoint:nth-child(5) {
  right: 0;
  top: 0;
  transform: translate(5%, -40%);
}

.fa-stamp {
  color: #000;
}

.btn {
  flex-grow: 1;
  border-radius: 100vmax;
  padding: 0.5em 0;
  font-size: 0.85rem;
  box-shadow: 0 5px 10px 0 rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.15);
  cursor: pointer;
}

.reminder-btn {
  color: #fff;
  background-color: #111827;
  border: 1px solid #1b1b1b;
}

.download-btn {
  border: 1px solid #eee;
  background-color: #fff;
}

/* ----------- */

hr {
  border: none;
  height: 1px;
  background-color: #ddd;
  margin: 0.75em 0;
}

/* payment info */

.payment-info {
  display: flex;
  justify-content: space-between;
  align-items: center;
  margin: 0.75em 1em;
  font-size: 1rem;
  color: #6b7280;
}

.card-info {
  display: flex;
  align-items: center;
  gap: 0.75em;
}

.card-icon {
  display: inline-block;
  width: 35px;
  height: 26px;
  background-color: #1a43bf;
  border-radius: 5px;
}

.pay-now-btn {
  font-size: 1.15rem;
  background-color: #111827;
  color: #fff;
  width: 100%;
  padding: 0.75em 0;
  border: 2px solid #1b1b1b;
  border-radius: 0.75em;
  box-shadow: 0 0 1px 0 #000, 0 5px 15px 0 rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.45);
  cursor: pointer;
}

@media (max-width: 424px) {
  h1 {
    font-size: 1.2rem;
  }

  .invoice {
    padding: 0.75em;
  }

  .invoice .title {
    position: relative;
    font-size: 1rem;
    padding: 0.5em 0;
  }

  .slot-hole {
    width: 95%;
  }
  .invoice {
    width: 90%;
  }

  .invoice .amount {
    font-size: 0.85rem;
  }

  .payers-list li p {
    font-size: 0.85rem;
  }

  .payers-list .pay-tag {
    font-size: 0.8rem;
  }

  .btn {
    padding: 0.5em 0;
    font-size: 0.8rem;
  }

  .payment-info {
    font-size: 0.95rem;
  }

  .pay-now-btn {
    font-size: 1.05rem;
  }
}

Color Interpolated SVG Arc Time Slider

Tabular numerals in the tooltip prevent text-jitter, resulting in a smooth, high-fidelity clock widget.

CSS Mask Glitch Image Effect

The CSS Mask Glitch Image Effect creates a high-performance glitch animation on an <img> element using pure CSS. By combining custom properties, an optimized set of -webkit-mask-position coordinates, and mask-composite: exclude (or xor), it slices the image into a dynamically shifting grid. The keyframe animation handles the rapid displacement of the mask slices without relying on external libraries or heavy JavaScript.
